patthana16.49:1.1: hetuñceva sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na hetu ceva na hetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassanaṃ appaṭighaṃ
patthana16.49:2.1: sahetukañceva na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na ahetuko ceva na na hetu ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana appaṭighaṃ hetuṃ ceva hetusampayuttaṃ
